spec.two_second_read: Two visible choices. One real brief. Make money from the work, or choose people and cars for the business.
spec.thesis: Build one continuous product experience around identifiable objects changing purpose. The opening reference is a paid opportunity from one viewpoint and an outgoing brief from the other; both audience names remain visible. Below it, the visitor handles a comparison, an intact Story, a real vehicle, authored work and delivered photographs before following one creator source through a returning customer relationship. The page gains depth from a few thin control materials and precise handoffs, not from card shells, decorative animation or explanatory paragraphs. Real coded previews open at useful scale, money retains its conditions, and every sequence ends in a truthful, still, inspectable state.

every_visible_string: Nothing is sent from this preview.
copy_budget.target: Hard first-phone-viewport limit: 35 rendered words at 390×844 for each default audience lens, including all visible controls and legible media lettering. Hard hero-meaning limit: 19 words, excluding navigation/actions and separately reporting lab/motion controls. Authored earning hero: 14 meaningful words; navigation 4; lab/motion 6; actions 4; inclusive 28 before embedded lettering. Authored business hero: 13 meaningful words; navigation 4; lab/motion 6; actions 5; inclusive 28 before embedded lettering. Before fee adds 2 when required. Complete default document pressure target: 260 to 360 words on phone and 280 to 390 on desktop; do not add copy to reach a minimum. Each earning act targets fewer than 25 act-local words, each business chapter 12 to 24, and final attribution 24 to 38 before separately reported shared page controls. The inventory is a union of strings across states, not a measured count. Region inventories establish repeated occurrences. Count after fonts/images settle, manually audit image lettering, and report default, alternate, expanded, error and reduced-motion states independently. Unknown lettering or mandatory copy that breaks the hard hero limit blocks approval; it does not authorize concealment, illegible type or dishonest cropping.

engineering_notes: This is art direction, not code. Build real React and CSS using existing bundled DM Sans and existing supported preview components. Keep V2 and production files untouched. FILE_MAP.md must name the implemented files and query contracts after repository inspection.

Use #F6F7F5 canvas, #17221E ink, #59655D secondary text, #DCE2DE separators, #FFFFFF working paper and #142019 for the deliberate business media run. Preserve Loopday's own approved colors inside its brand objects. No global image grade.

Typography: public display 52px/1.04 on phone, 44px at 320 and 76px/1.02 at 1440, weight 500; do not insert a headline simply to use this size. Chapter verbs 32px phone and 44px desktop; money 36px and 44px, weight 600 with tabular numerals; body/obligations 16px/24px; actions 14px/20px; secondary facts 13px/18px; noncritical labels at least 12px/16px.

The phone coordinates are nominal artboard positions for the resting 390×844 composition, not measured output or absolute positioning instructions. Flow layout governs the document. Alternate frames, real fixture wording, intrinsic aspect ratios and text zoom may increase height. The nominal default document is approximately 8,384px before fixture-driven changes; report the actual result.

Public canvas: 16px phone text datum, 12px at 320; 24px tablet gutters; 32px desktop outer gutters. At 1440 use a 1376px maximum public canvas and a 1280px maximum narrative stage. At 1920 cap the public canvas at 1600px while narrative stages remain at most 1280px. There is no app sidebar on the public page.

Layer order: canvas z0, original media z10, opaque reading/task paper z20, lenses z40, floating grips z50, modal scrim z60, modal task above scrim z70 and its compact header z80. Raising a task's stacking context does not change its material. Never place the modal below public navigation.

Navigation is fixed; narrative objects are not pinned on phone. Keep the compact lab/motion strip immediately beneath the navigation and sticky as part of the control stack after its initial position. Its backing is opaque canvas, not another lens. Anchor scroll margins must clear the complete control stack.

Keep at most two active backdrop-filter regions on phone and three on desktop, never nested, with visible blur area below 20% of the viewport. A hero audience lens or active inspection lens shares this budget with navigation. Off-screen lenses do not remain active.

Light lens recipe: rgba(255,255,255,0.58), blur 16px, saturation 1.16, 1px masked 135-degree edge from rgba(255,255,255,0.88) through rgba(255,255,255,0.16) to rgba(223,234,225,0.64), inset top highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.74), shadow 0 8px 28px rgba(46,74,60,0.09). Radius 18px for navigation, 14px for an active rail. Increase the reading backing or use opaque white if contrast fails.

Dark lens is restricted to controls over the dark public media stage: rgba(22,34,27,0.64), blur 16px, saturation 1.12, 1px rgba(235,246,237,0.26) edge, restrained white top highlight and shadow 0 8px 28px rgba(10,28,17,0.22). Opaque fallback is #17221E. Do not use it for rate or consequence text.

Only the controlled wow stages may use the optical-rim approximation. Clip an aria-hidden copy of the same static image to a 6 to 8px inner rim, scale 1.015 around the shared source origin, displace at most 1.5px, blur 0.5px and use opacity 0.34. The center stays stable. Do not duplicate a video decoder, sample unrelated media or distort text, QR or pass artwork.

Motion uses compositor transforms and opacity. Implement opening bounds with premeasured transforms and static overflow clipping; do not animate width, height, grid tracks or read layout during every frame. Direct comparison uses translated clipping planes with unchanged image proportions. Release temporary promotion and image copies after settling.

Reserve intrinsic image dimensions before loading. Select fixture-derived responsive images near their rendered size and device pixel ratio without unnecessarily delivering full originals. Start with only hero media eager; lazy-load later work, car and content assets. Preparing the alternate hero must not delay the leading reference.

No continuous idle animation, hover zoom, portrait parallax or automatic media carousel. At most one video decoder may run if a verified playable file exists. Supplied stills remain still; off-screen sequences pause and data-saving modes avoid speculative large downloads.

All actions have at least 44×44px targets. Use the bundled icon set, visible labels for primary actions and 2px #315E49 focus outlines with 3px offset on light surfaces; use white on dark surfaces. A closed modal restores its precise triggering control, not the top of the page.

Use native history for audience, frame and opened-preview state. Preserve page/filter context, scroll anchor and selected media. Reuse existing V3 query contracts after inspection rather than inventing unverified entity IDs or production URLs.

Scope the state inventories to the changed region. Shared controls and persistent source/identity objects remain unless explicitly replaced. Steps opens a complete labelled frame list for direct access; inactive frames are not focusable or exposed as concurrent active content. Reduced motion instead renders the ordered narrative content and receives its own count.

Resolve actual visible copy from all embedded workflow components before capture. Financial disclosure, signup agreement, error and commitment states have readable natural height and no artificial word cap. Missing required data blocks commitment.

Maintain MEDIA_MANIFEST.json, MATERIAL_SYSTEM.md, TEXT_COUNTS.md and PERFORMANCE.md under docs/design-lab-v3. Preserve the existing Loyalty architecture, privacy and Wallet research documents. Index this surface's captures and recordings in REPORT.md without claiming the other package items are complete.

spec.wow_moment: This surface carries all three required moments. 1. The work changes hands: a hard comparison boundary reveals separately authored creator work, that same verified work expands into the actual submission preview in 440ms, then moves 24px under a stationary narrow approval rail in 360ms. A registered 6 to 8px optical rim may displace only the same static source by 1.5px; the supplied approval snapshot reveals in 160ms and a supported ledger continuation aligns in 220ms. An unrelated approved latte must be an explicit separate example, never false continuity. 2. One part of a real car: Eli's intact photograph opens horizontally in 440ms; the real rear-door plan separates over 240ms; its supported zone reveals in 160ms; US$240 /month Asking rate moves 12px into alignment over 220ms. The final View action is never withheld. 3. The source never leaves: Jasmine's external source survives Story, trusted link, historical signup, a distinct zero-progress member QR, dated returns and the labelled September 17 reward continuation. The final pass moves aside while that unchanged marker becomes the heading of the existing 4/3/1 attribution descent. No public step creates a real event, edits the working store or redeems a reward. Each moment has direct state access, reduced-motion ordered objects, a stable endpoint and actual browser recordings.
